name: Fiona MacLeod
bio:
Fiona's journey into motorsport began not on the track, but in her father's engineering workshop in the Highlands. From rebuilding engines to tinkering with suspension systems, her early years instilled a deep understanding of mechanical intricacies. After graduating with honors in mechanical engineering from the University of Edinburgh, she joined a small racing team, rapidly rising through the ranks due to her sharp analytical skills and innovative solutions. 

Fiona's approach to engineering is both meticulous and forward-thinking. She believes in a data-driven approach, meticulously analyzing telemetry and performance metrics to identify areas for improvement. However, she also encourages creative problem-solving and is always open to exploring unconventional ideas. Her ambition drives her to constantly seek out new technologies and strategies to give her team a competitive edge, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and innovation.

physical.hairStyle: Long, thick, and usually pulled back in a practical braid during race weekends.
physical.description: A tall woman with a determined gaze and a practical, no-nonsense demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a worn-out multi-tool, a memento from her father.
Has a habit of sketching technical diagrams on napkins during meetings.
Insists on having a specific type of Scottish breakfast tea before every race.
